newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan cut to hold.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst George Salem said he cut J.P. Morgan & Co Inc to hold from buy
-- Analyst cuts 1997 EPS view to $7.50 from $8.00, 1996 EPS view remains $7.40
-- "There just doesn't seem to be much upward thrust to earnings," the analyst said
-- "Trading profits were inflated in the first half of the year," Salem said, adding that it was unsustainable as seen in Thursday's Q3 data
-- Analyst says J.P. Morgan "a great company" but there are better investment choices in the sector
